# frontend documentation

> Generated by compodoc 2.0.0 at 2026-07-26T16:15:33.505Z, llm-md export.

## Components

### AppComponent

File: `src/app/app.component.ts`
Selector: `app-root`
Standalone: yes

Description: Root shell of the application. Renders the header, the sidebar (current page name + "Back" button) and the where the active page is displayed.

Properties:
- `location: unknown = inject(Location)`
- `pageTitle: string = ''`
- `route: unknown = inject(ActivatedRoute)`
- `router: unknown = inject(Router)`
- `showBackButton: unknown = false`
- `title: string = 'Dachser app'`

Methods:
- `goBack(): void`
- `ngOnInit(): void`
- `updatePageTitle(): void` — Walks down to the deepest activated route (the one actually being rendered) and reads its data.pageTitle / data.showBack , since route data isn't automatically inherited by the root ActivatedRoute.

### ProfitLossCalculatorComponent

File: `src/app/pages/profit-loss-calculator-page/profit-loss-calculator.component.ts`
Selector: `app-profit-loss-calculator`
Standalone: yes

Description: "Calculate Profit" page. Loads the calculation history for the shipment coming from the route, lets the user enter income/costs, and submits the calculation to the backend. Implements the "Calculate Profit" use case described in the assessment document.

Properties:
- `fb: unknown = inject(FormBuilder)`
- `form: unknown = this.fb.group({ incomeValue: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]], costValue: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0)]], additionalCostValue: [0, […` — Flat form model for income/costs. It is translated into the nested DTO expected by the backend on submit.
- `loading: unknown = false`
- `results: ProfitLoss[] = []`
- `route: unknown = inject(ActivatedRoute)`
- `service: unknown = inject(ShipmentService)`
- `shipmentReference: string = ''`
- `snackBar: unknown = inject(MatSnackBar)`

Methods:
- `handleError(err: HttpErrorResponse): void` — Error handling — fulfils the "notifies in the UI" step of the use case.
- `ngOnInit(): void`
- `onCalculate(): void` — Validates the form and, if valid, sends the calculation request to the backend. On success, prepends the new result to the history and resets the form to zero. On failure (or invalid form), shows an error message via the snackbar.

### ProfitLossResultsComponent

File: `src/app/components/profit-loss-results/profit-loss-results.component.ts`
Selector: `app-profit-loss-results`
Standalone: yes

Description: Presentational ("dumb") component: receives data via @Input and only renders it in a sortable table. Knows nothing about services or HTTP.

Inputs:
- `data: ProfitLoss[] = []`
- `shipmentReference: string = ''`

Properties:
- `dataSource: unknown = new MatTableDataSource<ProfitLoss>([])`
- `displayedColumns: [] = [ 'totalIncome', 'totalCost', 'profitLossValue' ]`
- `sort: MatSort`

Methods:
- `ngAfterViewInit(): void`
- `ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void`

### StartPageComponent

File: `src/app/pages/start-page/start-page.component.ts`
Selector: `app-start-page`
Standalone: yes

Description: First page of the flow: lets the user pick an existing shipment reference from a closed dropdown (no free-text entry) and navigate to the "Calculate Profit" page for that shipment.

Properties:
- `router: unknown = inject(Router)`
- `selected: string = ''`
- `service: unknown = inject(ShipmentService)`
- `shipmentReferences: string[] = []`

Methods:
- `goToCalculate(): void` — Navigates to the calculation page for the currently selected shipment.
- `ngOnInit(): void`

## Services / Injectables

### ShipmentService

File: `src/app/services/service.ts`
providedIn: `root`

Description: Handles all HTTP communication with the Profit/Loss backend API. Kept free of UI concerns (no snackbars, no navigation) so it can be reused and tested independently of any component.

Properties:
- `baseUrl: string = '/api/profitLoss'`

Methods:
- `calculate(request: CalculationRequest): Observable<ProfitLoss>` — Submits income/cost data for a shipment and returns the calculated profit or loss.
- `getAllShipmentReferences(): Observable<string[]>` — Retrieves all shipment references available for selection on the start page.
- `getHistory(shipmentReference: string): Observable<ProfitLoss[]>` — Retrieves the calculation history for a given shipment reference.

## Interfaces

### CalculationRequest

File: `src/app/models/calculation.model.ts`

Description: Payload sent to POST /api/profitLoss/calculation.

Properties:
- `costs: Costs`
- `incomeValue: number`
- `shipmentReference: string`

### Costs

File: `src/app/models/calculation.model.ts`

Description: Cost breakdown submitted as part of a calculation request.

Properties:
- `additionalCostValue: number`
- `costValue: number`

### ErrorResponse

File: `src/app/models/error.model.ts`

Description: Shape of the error body returned by the backend on 4xx/5xx responses.

Properties:
- `message: string`
- `status: number`
- `timestamp: string`

### ProfitLoss

File: `src/app/models/calculation.model.ts`

Description: Result returned by the backend after a profit/loss calculation.

Properties:
- `calculatedOn: string`
- `profitLossValue: number`
- `shipmentReference: string`
- `totalCost: number`
- `totalIncome: number`

## Public variables

- `appConfig: ApplicationConfig = { providers: [ provideRouter(routes), provideAnimationsAsync(), provideHttpClient(), ] }` — Root application providers, wired up in main.ts via bootstrapApplication(). provideRouter: enables the routes defined in app.routes.ts. provideAnimationsAsync: required by Angular Material components (mat-sort-header, mat-form-field, mat-snack-bar, ...) that rely on animations. provideHttpClient: enables HttpClient injection (used by ShipmentService).
  Defined in `src/app/app.config.ts`
- `routes: Routes = [ { path: '', redirectTo: 'shipments', pathMatch: 'full' }, { path: 'shipments', component: StartPageComponent, data: { pageTitle: 'Shipment Select', showBack: …` — Application routes. Each route carries a data.pageTitle (shown in the sidebar by AppComponent) and a data.showBack flag (controls whether the "Back" button is displayed).
  Defined in `src/app/app.routes.ts`
